marketplace_batch_after_confirmation_and.description: Value beside "Listing activation": the listing goes live only after the attach transaction confirms and Counterparty verifies it. Counterparty is a protocol name and stays Latin.

marketplace_batch_asset_source.description: Label in the attach-and-list fact list, beside the address the asset comes from when it is not the seller's own address.

marketplace_batch_attach_and_list_asset.description: Title of the batch approval screen that attaches an asset to a UTXO and lists it in one phase. $1 is the asset name, e.g. RAREPEPE.

marketplace_batch_attach_collectibles_fo.description: Title of the batch approval screen that attaches collectibles to UTXOs so they can be listed. $1 is the number of collectibles.

marketplace_batch_attach_costs_are_paid_.message: Attach costs are paid first; payout requires a sale. The XCP fee may change at confirmation.
marketplace_batch_attach_costs_are_paid_.description: Timing note under the attach-and-list summary: the costs are spent now, the payout only arrives if the listing sells, and the XCP protocol fee is not final until the block confirms.

marketplace_batch_attach_fee.description: Label in the attach-and-list summary, beside the miner fee in sats paid by the attach transaction.

marketplace_batch_attach_network_fee.description: Label in the attach-and-list fact list, beside the miner fee in sats the attach transaction pays.

marketplace_batch_attach_transaction_onl.description: Value beside "Broadcast now" on the attach-and-list approval screen: only the attach transaction goes to the network now, the listing does not.

marketplace_batch_authorize_1_listing_re.description: Title of the batch approval screen when the batch changes the price of exactly one existing listing.

marketplace_batch_authorize_listing_repr.description: Title of the batch approval screen when every item changes the price of an existing listing. $1 is the number of listings repriced (2 or more).

marketplace_batch_authorize_marketplace_.description: Title of the batch approval screen that puts items up for sale. $1 is the number of listings.

marketplace_batch_broadcast.description: Label on the listing batch approval screen, beside whether the signed transactions go to the network now.

marketplace_batch_broadcast_now.description: Label in the attach-and-list fact list for what is broadcast immediately; its value is "Attach transaction only".

marketplace_batch_buyer_controls.description: Label on the listing batch approval screen for the parts of the transaction the buyer, not the seller, decides.

marketplace_batch_combined_asking_prices.description: Label on the listing batch approval screen, beside the summed asking price of every listing, in sats.

marketplace_batch_create_1_listing_utxo.description: Title of the fan-out batch approval screen when exactly one listing UTXO is created.

marketplace_batch_create_listing_utxos.description: Title of the fan-out batch approval screen. $1 is the number of listing UTXOs created (always 2 or more; the one-UTXO case has its own message).

marketplace_batch_every_attach_proves_it.message: Every attach proves its source, clean funding, new UTXO, miner fee, and local Counterparty message. XCP fees remain block-dependent until confirmation.
marketplace_batch_every_attach_proves_it.description: Notice under the batch approval screen for attaching or preparing assets: what the wallet checked on each transaction, and that the XCP protocol fee is only final once the block confirms.

marketplace_batch_every_fan_out_input_an.message: Every fan-out input and same-wallet output was proved before this batch can sign. No Counterparty asset moves in this phase.
marketplace_batch_every_fan_out_input_an.description: Notice under the fan-out batch approval screen: the wallet verified every input and output before allowing any signature, and this phase only splits BTC.

marketplace_batch_every_listing_independ.message: Every listing independently guarantees its seller payment. Each flexible signature remains valid until its attached asset outpoint is spent.
marketplace_batch_every_listing_independ.description: Notice under the listing batch approval screen: each listing pays the seller on its own terms, and each signature stays usable by a buyer until the seller spends that asset's UTXO.

marketplace_batch_funding_fees_and_deliv.description: Value beside "Buyer controls": the buyer chooses the funding inputs, the fees, and the address the asset is delivered to.

marketplace_batch_listing_activation.description: Label in the attach-and-list fact list for when the listing becomes live.

marketplace_batch_listing_price.description: Label on the attach-and-list approval screen, beside the asking price in sats.

marketplace_batch_new_utxos.description: Label on the fan-out batch approval screen, beside the count of UTXOs the batch creates.

marketplace_batch_not_broadcast_now.description: Value beside "Broadcast" on the listing batch approval screen: signing only authorizes the listings, nothing is sent to the network yet.

marketplace_batch_prepare_1_collectible.description: Title of the batch approval screen that prepares exactly one collectible for sale.

marketplace_batch_prepare_collectibles.description: Title of the batch approval screen that prepares collectibles for sale. $1 is the number of collectibles (always 2 or more; the single case has its own message).

marketplace_batch_quoted_xcp_fee.description: Label in the attach-and-list fact list, beside the quoted Counterparty protocol fee in XCP.

marketplace_batch_sats.description: A satoshi amount on the multi-transaction marketplace approval screen. $1 is the already-formatted whole number of satoshis. "sats" is the unit ticker and stays Latin.

marketplace_batch_seller_wallet.description: Label on the batch approval screen, beside the address that sells in every transaction of the batch.

marketplace_batch_signature_invalidation.description: Label in the batch approval fact list for the action that makes the signature the user is about to give unusable.

marketplace_batch_spend_each_attached_as.description: Value beside "Signature invalidation" on the listing batch approval screen: spending each asset's UTXO is what cancels the corresponding authorization.

marketplace_batch_spend_the_attached_ass.description: Value beside "Signature invalidation": spending the UTXO the asset is attached to is what invalidates the authorization.

marketplace_batch_the_attach_transaction.message: The attach transaction is broadcast first. The listing becomes available after confirmation and independent verification of the attached asset.
marketplace_batch_the_attach_transaction.description: Notice under the attach-and-list approval screen explaining the two-step order of the phase.

marketplace_batch_total_network_fees.description: Label on the batch approval screen, above the summed miner fee in sats.

marketplace_batch_total_quoted_xcp_fees.description: Label on the batch approval screen, beside the summed quoted Counterparty protocol fee in XCP.

marketplace_batch_transactions.description: Label on the batch approval screen, beside the number of transactions the batch will sign.

marketplace_batch_utxo_returned.description: Label in the attach-and-list summary, beside the sats held by the asset UTXO that come back to the seller on a sale.

marketplace_batch_xcp_fee_quote.description: Label in the attach-and-list summary, beside the quoted Counterparty protocol fee in XCP. XCP is a ticker and stays Latin.

marketplace_batch_your_payout_if_all_sel.description: Label on the listing batch approval screen, above the total the seller receives in sats if every listing in the batch sells.

marketplace_batch_your_payout_if_sold.description: Label on the attach-and-list approval screen, above the satoshi amount the seller receives if the listing sells.

marketplace_batch_your_utxo_sats_returne.description: Label in the batch approval fact list, beside the satoshis locked in the seller's asset UTXO that come back to the seller.

marketplace_bundle_accept_btc_for_with_f.message: Accept $1 BTC for $2 with fee bump
marketplace_bundle_accept_btc_for_with_f.description: Title of the approval screen where a seller accepts an exact offer and pays a child transaction to speed it up. $1 is the offer price in BTC with 8 decimals, $2 is the asset name.

marketplace_bundle_accept_offer_for.description: One-line action summary on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen. $1 is the asset being sold, or a short description of it.

marketplace_bundle_added_child_fee.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, beside the extra miner fee in sats the child transaction adds to speed up the parent.

marketplace_bundle_asset_detaches_to_thi.description: Note under the delivery address on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen when the asset is detached from its UTXO and credited to the address itself.

marketplace_bundle_asset_stays_attached_.message: Asset stays attached to a $1-sat UTXO at this address
marketplace_bundle_asset_stays_attached_.description: Note under the delivery address on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen when the asset stays attached to a UTXO. $1 is the value of that UTXO in sats.

marketplace_bundle_both_network_fees_are.message: Both network fees are already deducted from your final proceeds.
marketplace_bundle_both_network_fees_are.description: Timing note under the offer-acceptance bundle summary: the amount shown as received is already net of the parent and child miner fees.

marketplace_bundle_delivery.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, beside the address the sold asset is delivered to.

marketplace_bundle_network_fees.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, beside the combined miner fee of the parent and child transactions, in sats.

marketplace_bundle_offer_price.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, beside the buyer's offer in sats.

marketplace_bundle_parent_fee.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, beside the miner fee in sats of the parent transaction.

marketplace_bundle_parent_seller_proceed.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, beside the sats the parent transaction pays the seller before the child fee is taken out.

marketplace_bundle_quoted_package_rate.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, beside the fee rate in sat/vB quoted for the parent and child transactions together.

marketplace_bundle_sat_vb.description: A fee rate on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen. $1 is the rate with two decimals; sat/vB is the unit and stays Latin.

marketplace_bundle_sats.description: A satoshi amount on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen. $1 is the already-formatted whole number of satoshis. "sats" is the unit ticker and stays Latin.

marketplace_bundle_the_parent_completes_.message: The parent completes the exact sale and the child spends only your parent proceeds back to you. Both transactions were proved before either signature is requested.
marketplace_bundle_the_parent_completes_.description: Notice under the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen: the second (child) transaction only moves the seller's own proceeds back to the seller, and the wallet verified both transactions before asking for any signature.

marketplace_bundle_you_receive.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, above the sats the seller ends up with after both fees.

marketplace_bundle_your_proceeds_after_f.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, above the sats the seller keeps once the child fee-bump transaction is paid.

marketplace_bundle_your_utxo_sats_return.description: Label on the offer-acceptance bundle approval screen, beside the satoshis locked in the seller's asset UTXO that come back to the seller.

marketplace_intent_accept_offer.description: Short action summary at the top of the approval screen when the reader is the seller accepting an exact offer.

marketplace_intent_asset_detaches_to_thi.description: Note under the Delivery row on the exact-offer screen when delivery is detached: the single asset leaves its UTXO and lands on the address shown.

marketplace_intent_asset_source.description: Row label on the attach approval screen, above the address whose Counterparty balance the asset is taken from.

marketplace_intent_asset_stays_attached_.message: Asset stays attached to a $1-sat UTXO at this address
marketplace_intent_asset_stays_attached_.description: Note under the Delivery row when the buyer chose attached delivery: the asset is not detached, it arrives still bound to a UTXO the buyer owns. $1 is that UTXO's value in sats.

marketplace_intent_assets_detach_to_this.description: Note under the Delivery row on the checkout screen when the buyer chose detached delivery: the assets leave their UTXOs and land on the address shown. Plural — a basket can hold several.

marketplace_intent_broadcast.description: Row label on the listing approval screen, above a statement of whether the transaction goes to the network now.

marketplace_intent_buy_collectibles.description: Short action summary at the top of the marketplace checkout approval screen.

marketplace_intent_buyer_chooses_attache.message: Buyer chooses attached or detached delivery
marketplace_intent_buyer_chooses_attache.description: Value of the Delivery row on the listing approval screen: the seller's signature leaves the delivery method open, and the buyer picks it. 'Attached' and 'detached' are the Counterparty UTXO terms.

marketplace_intent_buyer_controls.description: Row label on the listing approval screen, above the list of transaction parts the seller's signature does not fix.

marketplace_intent_buyer_funding.description: Row label on the exact-offer approval screen, above the total sats the buyer's input must supply.

marketplace_intent_buyer_funding_utxo.description: Row label on the exact-offer approval screen shown to the seller, above the outpoint the buyer's funding comes from.

marketplace_intent_cancellation.description: Row label on the exact-offer approval screen, above how the bidder can withdraw the offer.

marketplace_intent_change.description: Label on the marketplace approval screen, above the Bitcoin change returning to the reader's own address.

marketplace_intent_collectibles_count.description: Subtitle under the checkout action summary when the basket holds more than one collectible. $1 is the count (2 or more).

marketplace_intent_deducted_from_seller_.description: Note under the 'Network fee' row on the exact-offer approval screen: the miner fee comes out of what the seller receives.

marketplace_intent_delist_without_a_tran.description: Value of the 'Marketplace cancellation' row: the seller can remove the listing off-chain, with no Bitcoin transaction and no fee.

marketplace_intent_delivery.description: Row label on the marketplace approval screen. Its value is either the address the asset is delivered to, or a sentence about who chooses the delivery method.

marketplace_intent_fee_recipient.description: Row label on the exact-offer approval screen, above the address the platform fee is paid to.

marketplace_intent_finalized_at_confirma.description: Note under the 'Quoted XCP fee' row: the quote can still move, and the real amount is fixed only when the transaction confirms.

marketplace_intent_funding_fees_and_deli.description: Value of the 'Buyer controls' row on the listing approval screen: the parts of the transaction the buyer, not the seller, decides.

marketplace_intent_funding_input.description: Row label on the fan-out approval screen, above the sats on the single input being split up.

marketplace_intent_funding_utxo.description: Row label on the exact-offer approval screen shown to the bidder, above the outpoint their own funding comes from. Spending it withdraws the offer.

marketplace_intent_items.description: Row label on the marketplace checkout approval screen, above how many collectibles are in the basket.

marketplace_intent_items_with_asset_coun.description: Value of the Items row when the basket holds more than one item of the same asset. $1 is the item count, $2 is how many distinct assets those items span.

marketplace_intent_list_for_sale.description: Short action summary at the top of the marketplace approval screen when the signature creates a new listing.

marketplace_intent_marketplace_cancellat.description: Row label on the listing approval screen, above how the seller can withdraw the listing.

marketplace_intent_marketplace_expiry.description: Row label on the marketplace approval screen, above the date and time the marketplace stops honouring this listing or offer.

marketplace_intent_network_fee.description: Label on the marketplace approval screen, above the sats paid to Bitcoin miners.

marketplace_intent_new_utxo_owner.description: Row label on the attach approval screen, above the address that will control the newly created asset UTXO.

marketplace_intent_new_utxo_value.description: Row label on the attach approval screen, above the sats carried by the newly created asset UTXO.

marketplace_intent_new_utxos.description: Row label on the fan-out approval screen, above how many UTXOs are created and what each is worth.

marketplace_intent_none_requested.description: Value of the 'Marketplace expiry' row when the site asked for no expiry at all.

marketplace_intent_not_broadcast_now.description: Value of the Broadcast row on the listing approval screen: signing only authorizes the listing, it does not send a transaction.

marketplace_intent_notice_accept_exact_o.message: Your signature completes this exact sale without a buyer callback. If the buyer already spent the shared funding UTXO, broadcast fails and your asset remains yours.
marketplace_intent_notice_accept_exact_o.description: Info notice on the exact-offer approval screen shown to the seller: signing finishes the sale on its own, and a buyer who already withdrew simply makes the broadcast fail.

marketplace_intent_notice_authorize_exac.message: After signing, this seller can complete this exact trade without another approval. Other exact offers backed by the same funding UTXO are alternatives: the first confirmed spend wins and invalidates its siblings.
marketplace_intent_notice_authorize_exac.description: Info notice on the exact-offer approval screen shown to the bidder, explaining that their signature is standing authorization and that competing offers on the same UTXO cancel each other.

marketplace_intent_notice_bulk_fanout_ou.message: Every output remains controlled by this wallet. These plain-Bitcoin UTXOs fund later Counterparty attach transactions; no asset moves in this phase.
marketplace_intent_notice_bulk_fanout_ou.description: Info notice on the fan-out approval screen: nothing leaves the wallet and no asset is touched, the transaction only splits Bitcoin into funding slots.

marketplace_intent_notice_sighash_all_at.message: SIGHASH_ALL fixes every input, seller payment, fee, change output, and the separate buyer-owned asset UTXO shown above.
marketplace_intent_notice_sighash_all_at.description: Info notice on the checkout approval screen with attached delivery, stating what the buyer's signature commits to. SIGHASH_ALL is the Bitcoin signature flag and stays Latin.

marketplace_intent_notice_sighash_all_de.message: SIGHASH_ALL fixes every input, seller payment, fee, change output, and the detach destination shown above.
marketplace_intent_notice_sighash_all_de.description: Info notice on the checkout approval screen with detached delivery, stating what the buyer's signature commits to. SIGHASH_ALL is the Bitcoin signature flag and stays Latin.

marketplace_intent_offer_price.description: Label on the exact-offer approval screen, above the sats the bidder is offering for the asset.

marketplace_intent_offer_price_platform_.message: Offer price, platform fee, and any attached delivery UTXO
marketplace_intent_offer_price_platform_.description: Note under the 'Buyer funding' row, listing what that amount is made of.

marketplace_intent_offer_to_buy.description: Short action summary at the top of the approval screen when the reader is the bidder making an exact offer.

marketplace_intent_one_collectible.description: Subtitle under the checkout action summary when the basket holds exactly one collectible.

marketplace_intent_operation_expiry.description: Row label on the marketplace approval screen, above the date and time this prepared operation stops being valid.

marketplace_intent_paid_by_the_buyer.description: Note under the 'Platform fee' row on the exact-offer approval screen: the buyer covers this fee, not the seller.

marketplace_intent_platform_fee.description: Label on the marketplace approval screen, above the sats paid to the marketplace itself. Distinct from the Bitcoin network fee.

marketplace_intent_quoted_xcp_fee.description: Row label on the attach approval screen, above the XCP protocol fee the site quoted. The final amount is only settled when the transaction confirms.

marketplace_intent_reprice_listing.description: Short action summary at the top of the marketplace approval screen when the signature changes the price of an existing listing.

marketplace_intent_sale_price.description: Label on the marketplace approval screen, above the listing price in sats.

marketplace_intent_sats_kept_with_your_a.description: Label on the marketplace approval screen, above the sats that stay locked in the UTXO the asset is attached to. The reader still owns them.

marketplace_intent_seller_receives.description: Label on the exact-offer approval screen shown to the bidder, above the sats the seller will get.

marketplace_intent_seller_subtotal.description: Label on the marketplace checkout approval screen, above the sats going to sellers before fees.

marketplace_intent_signature_invalidatio.description: Row label on the listing approval screen, above what the seller must do on-chain to make their signature unusable.

marketplace_intent_spend_the_asset_utxo.description: Value of the 'Signature invalidation' row: spending the UTXO the asset sits on kills the listing signature.

marketplace_intent_still_yours_separate_.message: Still yours, separate from the offer cost
marketplace_intent_still_yours_separate_.description: Note under the 'Sats kept with your asset' row on the exact-offer screen: those sats are not spent, they simply move with the asset.

marketplace_intent_still_yours_separate_.message: Still yours, separate from the purchase cost and change
marketplace_intent_still_yours_separate_.description: Note under the 'Sats kept with your asset' row on the checkout screen: those sats are not spent, they simply move with the asset.

marketplace_intent_title_accept_btc_for_.description: Headline of the exact-offer approval screen shown to the seller. $1 is the offer price in BTC, $2 is the asset with its quantity when known (e.g. '1 RAREPEPE') or just the asset name.

marketplace_intent_title_attach_asset_fo.description: Headline of the approval screen for an attach done as part of listing an asset for sale. $1 is the asset name (e.g. RAREPEPE). 'Attach' is the Counterparty operation that binds an asset to a UTXO.

marketplace_intent_title_authorize_btc_f.description: Headline of the exact-offer approval screen shown to the bidder. $1 is the offer price in BTC (e.g. 0.00250000), $2 is the asset with its quantity when known (e.g. '1 RAREPEPE') or just the asset name.

marketplace_intent_title_buy_collectible.description: Headline of the marketplace checkout approval screen when the basket holds more than one collectible. $1 is the count (2 or more), $2 is the total price in BTC.

marketplace_intent_title_buy_one_collect.description: Headline of the marketplace checkout approval screen when the basket holds exactly one collectible. $1 is the total price in BTC (e.g. 0.00250000).

marketplace_intent_title_create_listing_.description: Headline of the approval screen for a fan-out transaction that creates several plain-Bitcoin UTXOs to fund later listings. $1 is how many (2 or more).

marketplace_intent_title_create_one_list.description: Headline of the approval screen for a fan-out transaction that creates exactly one plain-Bitcoin UTXO to fund a later listing.

marketplace_intent_title_list_asset_for_.description: Headline of the marketplace approval screen for a new listing. $1 is the asset name (e.g. RAREPEPE), $2 is the price in BTC (e.g. 0.00250000). The quantity is always exactly 1.

marketplace_intent_title_prepare_asset.description: Headline of the approval screen for an attach that moves an asset onto its own UTXO ahead of listing it. $1 is the asset name (e.g. RAREPEPE).

marketplace_intent_title_reprice_asset_t.description: Headline of the marketplace approval screen when an existing listing's price changes. $1 is the asset name, $2 is the new price in BTC. The quantity is always exactly 1.

marketplace_intent_unavailable.description: Stands in for the 'You pay if accepted' amount when the wallet could not compute it safely.

marketplace_intent_withdraw_by_spending_.message: Withdraw by spending your funding UTXO
marketplace_intent_withdraw_by_spending_.description: Value of the Cancellation row: the bidder cancels the offer by spending the UTXO that backs it.

marketplace_intent_you_pay.description: Label on the marketplace checkout approval screen, above the total sats leaving the buyer's wallet.

marketplace_intent_you_pay_if_accepted.description: Label on the exact-offer approval screen shown to the bidder, above what leaves their wallet only if the seller accepts the offer.

marketplace_intent_you_receive.description: Label on the marketplace approval screen, above what the reader gets out of the trade — an asset quantity for a buyer, sats for a seller.

marketplace_intent_your_payout_if_sold.description: Label on the marketplace approval screen, above the sats the seller receives if their listing sells. Seller's own screen, so 'your'.

marketplace_intent_your_utxo_sats_return.description: Label on the marketplace approval screen, above the sats locked in the seller's asset UTXO that come back to them when the listing sells.

composer_verification_output_recipient_m.message: The outputs before this transaction's data ($1) would be read as a combined recipient instead of $2. It was not accepted.
composer_verification_output_recipient_m.description: Multiple destination outputs before Counterparty data are joined by the parser. $1 is the complete list of exact amount/address descriptions; $2 is the intended recipient address.

composer_verification_output_unexplained.message: This transaction pays an output your request does not account for ($1), so it was not accepted.
composer_verification_output_unexplained.description: $1 describes the exact amount and address of one output the user's request does not account for. Do not imply this is always an unknown address; it can be a named address paid the wrong amount.

composer_verification_output_unexplained.message: This transaction pays outputs your request does not account for ($1), so it was not accepted.
composer_verification_output_unexplained.description: $1 is the full list of exact amounts and addresses of multiple outputs the request does not account for.
